name: Even steps
rationale: Two-point steps from T-high through the wheel.

name: Wheel at twelve
rationale: Two-point steps through 7-high, then a four-point wheel bonus.

name: Five-point finish
rationale: The top three awards rise in even five-point steps.

name: Even steps
rationale: Even awards from T-high onward, with 9-high and 8-high sharing a tier.

name: Consecutive finish
rationale: One-point steps in each half of the table, separated by a three-point increase.

name: Ten-point ceiling
rationale: Simple lower awards and a shared ten-point prize for 7-high and the wheel.

name: Three-point steps
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 0 / 3 / 6 / 9 / 12. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 0 / 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 / 15.
rationale: High-card hand + 4-card badugi to qualify. Both halves rise in equal three-point steps.

name: Paying tens
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 1 / 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 / 12.
rationale: High-card hand + 4-card badugi to qualify. Low points rise one at a time; badugi points rise mostly in threes and finish at twelve.

name: One-point steps
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5.
rationale: High-card hand + 3-card badugi to qualify. Both halves rise in equal one-point steps. Badugi points still require four cards.

name: Two- and four-point steps
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 0 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 0 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16.
rationale: High-card hand + 4-card badugi to qualify. Low points rise in twos; badugi points start in twos and finish in fours.

name: Paying tens
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 10. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 10.
rationale: High-card hand + 4-card badugi to qualify. Mostly two-point steps, with both halves capped at ten.

name: Three-card qualifier
summary: Qualifying push. Low points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / wheel): 0 / 1 / 1 / 2 / 4. Four-card badugi points (T / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5): 0 / 1 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 6.
rationale: High-card hand + 3-card badugi to qualify. Shared lower tiers and two-point steps for the top awards. Badugi points still require four cards.
